hypothesis: A pairwise 3B tournament over 4 independent RAG draws should pick the best-coverage set better than absolute scoring, because relative judgment ("which set is better?") is an easier task for the 3B than absolute judgment.
technique: Four independent RAG-prompted draws at temperatures [0.3, 0.5, 0.7, 0.9] feed a single-elimination pairwise tournament: each match shows the 3B both full 7-question sets in both orderings (two-order vote to damp position bias), ties broken to the lower-temperature incumbent; the tournament winner is returned verbatim.
